curiosity: Why does squeezing a high-speed fluid into a narrow constriction cause its pressure to violently drop instead of building up?

titles.desktop: The Secret Physics of the Venturi Effect: Fluid Pressure Drop in Code
titles.shorts: The Venturi Paradox That Breaks Intuition #Shorts

desktop_mission.mission_sub: Incompressible Continuity, Bernoulli Suction & Dynamic Head Loss
desktop_mission.voice_mission: Today we're simulating the Venturi effect and Bernoulli pressure drops in Kotlin.
math_cards: Fluid must accelerate rapidly through the constriction to transport constant volume flow rate
Kinetic energy density surge in the throat forces static pressure to plummet to conserve total mechanical energy
Vertical piezometer tubes reveal the local static pressure deficit through differential liquid column depression
desktop_mission.voice_math: The core physics: mass continuity acceleration, Bernoulli pressure deficit, and hydrostatic manometer elevation.

math_steps.note: Constricting pipe diameter forces the fluid stream to accelerate to preserve constant mass throughput
math_steps.code:
// 1. Incompressible mass conservation: Q = A1 * v1 = A2 * v2
val areaRatio = area1M2 / max(area2M2, 1e-7f)
val volumeFlowRateM3S = area1M2 * inletVelocityMs
val throatVelocityMs = inletVelocityMs * areaRatio
math_steps.sub_desc: Evaluates fluid velocity surge through pipe constriction.

math_steps.badge: EQUATION 2 OF 3 • BERNOULLI STATIC PRESSURE DROP
math_steps.note: Surging kinetic energy in the narrow throat drives an equal and opposite collapse in static fluid pressure
math_steps.code:
// 2. Bernoulli's principle: exchange between kinetic and static pressure
val dynamicPressure1Pa = 0.5f * fluidDensityKgM3 * inletVelocityMs * inletVelocityMs
val dynamicPressure2Pa = 0.5f * fluidDensityKgM3 * throatVelocityMs * throatVelocityMs
val deltaPPa = dynamicPressure2Pa - dynamicPressure1Pa
val throatPressurePa = max(0f, p1Pa - deltaPPa)
math_steps.sub_desc: Calculates local static pressure collapse and suction potential.

math_steps.note: Differential liquid column height directly measures the Bernoulli pressure deficit across the throat
math_steps.code:
// 3. Hydrostatic column height difference in vertical piezometers
val h1M = (p1Pa - atmPa) / (fluidDensityKgM3 * g)
val h2M = (throatPressurePa - atmPa) / (fluidDensityKgM3 * g)
val deltaHM = (h1M - h2M).coerceAtLeast(0f)
math_steps.sub_desc: Computes piezometer column depression and discharge coefficient.

mystery.en: Why does squeezing water into a narrow pipe cause its pressure to violently drop instead of rising?

en.title: Venturi Tube & Pressure Drop
en.teaser: Accelerating fluid through a constriction converts static pressure into kinetic energy, generating powerful suction.

en.hook: Why does squeezing water into a narrow pipe cause its pressure to violently drop instead of skyrocketing?
en.math: Mass continuity forces the fluid to accelerate, trading static pressure for kinetic energy by Bernoulli's principle.
en.question: Can we simulate the Venturi effect, manometer columns, and cavitation live in Kotlin Multiplatform?
